description: Source code for importing and processing archive files in the Focalboard server application, including functions for reading ZIP archives, converting legacy formats, and managing boards and blocks.

methods.name: ImportArchive
methods.description: Imports an archive ZIP file containing boards, images, and content, handling legacy formats and extracting files.

methods.name: fixImagesAttachments
methods.description: Updates image and attachment blocks with new file IDs after import.

methods.name: ImportBoardJSONL
methods.description: Imports a JSONL formatted file containing blocks for a single board, creating board and block objects.

methods.name: blockToBoard
methods.description: Converts a legacy block into a board object, extracting properties from block fields.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Helper to extract string value from a map by key.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Helper to extract boolean value from a map by key.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Helper to extract integer value from a map by key.

methods.name: mapValue
methods.description: Helper to extract a map value from a map by key.

methods.name: arrayMapsValue
methods.description: Helper to extract an array of maps from a map by key.

methods.name: parseVersionFile
methods.description: Reads and parses version.json to determine archive version.
